page.notes: Left margin fragments belong to the facing page and were not transcribed. Words "statutum", "sancitum" and "potest" are read from the scan with long s rendered as s. The Greek word "ἐπιεικεία" is a close reading of a small, worn Greek word and may be imperfect.
